name: INTERACTION: Interactive Trajectories in Dense Traffic Dataset
description: International naturalistic vehicle and pedestrian trajectory dataset captured with aerial drones and traffic cameras across roundabouts, intersections, and merging ramps in the US, China, and Germany, featuring highly interactive multi-agent traffic and Lanelet2 HD semantic maps.

publisher.name: UC Berkeley / Karlsruhe Institute of Technology / Tsinghua University

source_references.notes: Primary research paper by Zhan et al. detailing the aerial collection methodology and international driving benchmarks.

verification.notes: Verified against official GitHub repository and arXiv paper (DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1910.00547).

size.notes: Exact aggregate byte size is not formally published on the project portal; distributed as trajectory CSV tables and Lanelet2 OSM semantic maps.

citation.paper_title: INTERACTION Dataset: An INTERnational, Adversarial and Cooperative Motion Dataset in Interactive Driving Scenarios with Semantic Maps

provenance.collection_method: Captured using aerial drones and pole-mounted cameras at highly interactive traffic bottlenecks (roundabouts, signalized intersections, merging highway ramps) in the US, China, and Germany.
provenance.curation_notes: Provides millimeter-precision vehicle and pedestrian tracks paired with detailed Lanelet2 semantic vector maps; designed to evaluate adversarial, cooperative, and highly interactive multi-agent behaviors.
data_sources: High-resolution drone and stationary sensor recordings in Germany, China, and USA
